answer.summary: The API Types Check fails deterministically because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. The Javadoc on XtmPeerTokenInput (XtmPeerTokenInput.java, touched by this PR) changed, so the regenerated file differs from the committed one. Re-running will fail the same way. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api against a running API and commit the updated api-types.d.ts.
